name: Victor Group Holdings Limited
summary: Victor Group Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides infrastructure as a service, software as a service, and platform as a service solution primarily in the People's Republic of China and Australia. The company also operates cloud-based platform for education and remote application services, as well as offers e-learning solutions to educational institutions, students, and parents. Victor Group Holdings Limited was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.
